scientific_limitations: Theorem assumes a real symmetric positive-definite quadratic potential and exact jointly sampled Brownian increments and integrals.
The finite positive exact-invariance step applies only to isotropic curvature, not arbitrary Gaussian or nonlinear targets.
Physical-time averaging comparison uses stationary initialization and contrasts the discrete stepwise average with a continuous-time diffusion average.
The accessible bibliographic comparisons do not exclude unindexed equivalent calculations.
